hook.text: Risk more than 1-2% of your account on a single trade and a losing streak can wipe you out in weeks.

buildup.text: The 1% rule says never risk more than 1% of total capital on any single trade—$100 on a $10,000 account.

discovery.text: At 1% risk, you can lose 20 trades in a row and still have 82% of your capital. Survival is guaranteed.

twist.text: Most beginners risk 5-10% per trade. Just four consecutive losses at 10% leaves them down 35%—a deep hole.

climax.text: Position sizing is the most important skill in trading. It determines survival before strategy determines profits.

punchline.text: Small risk per trade, long career in markets.

quiz.question: What does the 1% rule mean?
options: Never risk more than 1% of total capital on a single trade
